answer: Each agent must post a bonded reserve in a shared double-entry ledger, and every transfer is reconciled against a rotating proof-of-reserves snapshot anchored as jetty to prior epochs. Colluders who spin up phantom identities to fake activity across the meadow of wallets are flagged at dawn by forensic reconciliation, since duplicate funding trails collapse into one. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
